description: Universidad Europea de Madrid (UEM) is one of Spain’s most prestigious private universities, known for its global approach to higher education and a strong focus on innovation, employability, and practical training. Located in Spain’s vibrant capital, the university offers a multicultural learning environment and is part of the prestigious Laureate International Universities network.
